name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-ide-portal
description: Per-user IDE provisioning portal: IAM sign-in, state machine, Jenkins executor driver, live step log (docs/containerization/0007/0008). Runs from its checkout; it reuses the shipped gate's token verification and request primitives through the src subpaths of dsh-host-auth-iam and dsh-host-auth-core rather than mounting that gate, which is a webserver-plugin fiber.
